description: This PHP trait, SubunitIdChainTrait, provides functionality to retrieve and cache a chain of subunit IDs for an entity, utilizing methods and services from the OrangeHRM project, specifically related to company structure. It includes a getter method that throws an exception if a required method is missing, and interacts with an external service to fetch data.

methods.name: getSubunitIdChain
methods.description: Returns the chain of subunit IDs associated with the entity, fetching and caching the data using an external service if not already cached.
